description: Asks how a numeric operand compares with numeric text "7" and nonnumeric text "q" in the literal lane (each comparison its own SELECT), the stored-field lane (Vals.T = '7', Vals.Q = 'q', Vals.L, Vals.D), the declared-parameter lane (PARAMETERS pn Long, pt Text) and the undeclared-parameter lane: result tag and value, or the failure. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: PARAMETERS pn Long, pt Text; SELECT pn = pt AS eq, pn < pt AS lt FROM One
SELECT [ua] = [ub] AS eq, [ua] < [ub] AS lt FROM One
